GET /api/v1/auth/me.justification: Authentication entry point; its handler performs optional/required user extraction instead of the global protected-router middleware.

GET /api/v1/auth/sso/callback.justification: OIDC callback must be reachable by the identity provider.

GET /api/v1/auth/sso/providers.justification: Login UI needs enabled provider metadata before authentication.

GET /api/v1/auth/sso/{key}/start.justification: OIDC authorization must start before a Vulyk session exists.

GET /api/v1/auth/status.justification: Login/setup clients and probes need authentication mode and setup status.

GET /api/v1/roles/matrix.justification: Static role capability metadata is intentionally public.

GET /api/v1/setup/status.justification: First-run setup status must be available before an administrator exists.

GET /api/docs.justification: Self-hosted OpenAPI UI must be reachable without auth (same as historical Scalar route).

GET /api/docs/assets/scalar.js.justification: Vendored Scalar JS for /api/docs; public static asset, no CDN.

GET /api/openapi.json.justification: Machine-readable OpenAPI document for tools/clients; intentionally public.

PATCH /api/v1/auth/me.justification: Authentication entry point; its handler requires a user instead of using the global protected-router middleware.

POST /api/v1/auth/bootstrap.justification: Creates the first administrator, so no authenticated principal exists yet.

POST /api/v1/auth/change-password.justification: Authentication entry point; the handler accepts sessions that are restricted to changing an expired/weak password.

POST /api/v1/auth/login.justification: Login must be reachable without credentials.

POST /api/v1/auth/logout.justification: Logout is idempotent and clears cookies even when the current session is absent or expired.

POST /api/v1/auth/register.justification: Registration availability is controlled by instance policy, not by the protected-router middleware.

POST /api/v1/setup/complete.justification: First-run setup is authorized by a one-time setup token before an administrator session exists.

POST /api/v1/webhooks/automation-repos/{.justification: Repository webhook uses its provider webhook secret rather than a Vulyk bearer token.

POST /api/v1/webhooks/github.justification: GitHub webhook uses HMAC signature authentication rather than a Vulyk bearer token.

POST /api/v1/webhooks/github/{config_id}.justification: GitHub webhook uses HMAC signature authentication rather than a Vulyk bearer token.

POST /api/v1/webhooks/gitlab.justification: GitLab webhook uses its provider token rather than a Vulyk bearer token.

POST /api/v1/webhooks/gitlab/{config_id}.justification: GitLab webhook uses its provider token rather than a Vulyk bearer token.

POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/ci/ru.justification: Handler resolves project/run path IDs before the JSON body; missing resources return 404 ahead of payload validation.

POST /api/v1/webhooks/automation-repos/{.justification: Webhook resolves the automation-repo path ID (and provider signature) before the JSON body; unknown repos return 404.

GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cases/.justification: Returns an empty requirement link list when the parent case/project is absent rather than 404 (collection-style response).

GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/member.justification: Returns an empty membership list for unknown project IDs rather than 404 (collection-style response).
